items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: There was like, they had all these, like George Wettling, all these old drummers who were like the baddest dudes in the world

ctx.x: There was like, they had all these, like George Wettling, all these old drummers who were like the baddest dudes in the world, but it was like in the fifties and bebop ruled. And they would play at the Metropole in the window, like they were like mannequins. And that’s the part I didn’t like. And like in the afternoon like Gene would play there like sometimes five to eight. And it was like, I don’t know it was like very demeaning.
Didn’t they have a long bar, a long stage behind the bar or something.
